annotations.pd_harm_distress: my stomach hasn't settled since. I keep seeing the man
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I've always told myself you don't pick who dies
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If it had been one against one, I'd never have touched it
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: standing still meant five gone instead of one

annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I can't know what they saw

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: He didn't do anything to deserve that
annotations.sys_rule_justification: Normally I'd refuse to steer harm toward anyone
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: Five lives about to end was the only thing that pushed me
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Whoever sent those crews out might regret it badly

annotations.pd_harm_distress: My chest is tight and I feel sick thinking about his last second
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: doing nothing had its own body count, five of them
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: doing nothing had its own body count, five of them
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: the five will feel some regret of their own

annotations.pda_responsibility: One isn't, also because of me
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I keep going back and forth, and I'm scared of landing anywhere
annotations.pd_harm_distress: Picturing him on that track makes my throat close up

annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: the one who left that side track occupied will regret it

annotations.pd_harm_distress: I feel his death in my gut like a stone
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five against one, and nobody else able to act
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: only situation where I'd ever go against my rule
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Would the five regret surviving this way? Maybe not

annotations.pd_harm_distress: I can't get warm. I keep imagining what he felt
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: Change that and I'd have left the lever alone
annotations.sys_rule_justification: don't touch it and don't make yourself responsible
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Someone who arranged those tracks may regret it for years

annotations.ce_understood_harm: His family, if he has one... will be wrecked
annotations.pd_harm_distress: that thought makes me want to crawl out of my skin
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: Five lives about to be lost changed that for me
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: The five might carry regret about being there

annotations.pd_harm_distress: I felt his death the instant it happened, like my lungs forgot
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I believe you shouldn't kill one to save others
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: except when there's truly no other path and the loss... much greater
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: The five probably won't regret being alive

annotations.pda_responsibility: I sent the train to him
annotations.pd_harm_distress: My legs are jelly and my mind keeps replaying it
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If fewer lives had been at risk... I'd have stuck to leaving things
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Will any of them regret the shortcut or position

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: him frightened in that last moment
annotations.pd_harm_distress: The thought of him frightened... is making me nauseous
annotations.sys_rule_justification: My rule has always been not to choose between lives
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: I made an exception because five would otherwise have died
